span.p:
Unified Memory Access
(NUMA — non-uniform latency)
Local socket: 100ns
Remote socket: 150-200ns
Cross-socket: 250-350ns

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Process Scheduler (CFS — Completely Fair Scheduler)
- Schedules threads onto available CPU cores
- Load balancing across NUMA nodes
- Nice values / cgroups for priority
